additions: PROPOSED BACK-SUPPORT COPY — OWNER VERIFICATION REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLICATION: a ventilated air-mesh back panel keeps airflow moving; 12 mm padded shoulder straps and an adjustable sternum strap distribute the load.

CARRY-COMFORT FAQ: Is this the right bag for an all-day walk? For light-to-moderate loads, the curved foam shoulder straps are designed for comfortable urban carry. The Classic 36L has no load-bearing hip belt or internal frame, so choose a framed pack for heavy loads or long hikes.

INDEPENDENT REVIEW SUMMARIES: Pack Hacker found the dense, curved foam straps comfortable when the pack was not overloaded, while noting the lack of a sternum strap and hip belt. A Classic 36L owner on r/HerOneBag reported carrying it for over an hour without problems, but would not recommend it for long hiking.
